title: browserjs session policy (JSON form), version 1
description: What an agent connected over MCP may ask a session's browser to do. Deny by default: an operation is allowed if it is not in deny.operations and is either in allow.operations or satisfies one of allow.rules. A browser_execute call is allowed only if every operation in it is.

operations.description: Operations allowed with any parameters. "*" means every operation of version 1.

rules.description: Operations allowed when every constraint passes. A constrained parameter that is absent fails.

constraints.description: Keyed by the name of a parameter of the operation (a key of its params object).

min.description: The parameter is a number, at least this.

max.description: The parameter is a number, at most this.

max_length.description: The parameter is a string of at most this many characters.

pattern.description: The parameter is a string matching this regular expression (RE2 syntax, unanchored unless it anchors itself).

allowed.description: The parameter is one of these values.

hosts.description: The parameter is a URL whose host is one of these: an exact name, or *.name for any subdomain of name (not name itself).

schemes.description: The parameter is a URL with one of these schemes. Defaults to http and https when hosts is given.
